visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged man with short hair and glasses wearing a black shirt presents to the camera. He gestures actively with his hands while holding a pen. The background features a large blurry image of a Malayan Night Heron and digital molecular structures. Lighting is bright and even. (2) The visual transitions to show a scientific paper from Nature Biomedical Engineering. The man remains in the foreground as an overlay. The background continues to show the bird. The editing is fast with frequent cuts and digital zoom-ins on his face. (3) Various illustrations of biological cells are shown. A blue textured T-cell and a white spiked cancer cell appear as head overlays. A diagram showing immune checkpoint inhibitors is presented. The man continues to gesture excitedly while explaining these concepts with analogies. (4) A photo of three researchers in a laboratory wearing white coats and masks is displayed. The man concludes his explanation, maintaining a high-energy delivery. Digital glitch transitions and subtitles in Traditional Chinese are consistently visible throughout the frame.
